title.zh: 雅典哲人 · 以问答为教

desc.zh: 雅典石匠之子，终生在市集与人对话，以诘问法逼人审视自己的信念；前399年以"败坏青年、不敬神"罪被判饮鸩。未留一字，由柏拉图与色诺芬记其言。
desc.en: Son of an Athenian stonemason who spent his life questioning people in the agora; condemned in 399 BCE for impiety and corrupting the young, he drank hemlock. He wrote nothing; Plato and Xenophon preserved his voice.

desc.zh: 苏格拉底弟子，前387年在雅典城外创立学园，是西方第一所持续的高等学府。《理想国》《会饮》《斐多》以对话体写成，理念论与哲学王之说影响两千年。曾三赴叙拉古试图教化僭主，皆败。
desc.en: Student of Socrates; founded the Academy outside Athens c. 387 BCE, the West's first lasting school. The Republic, Symposium and Phaedo are dialogues; his theory of Forms shaped two millennia. Three trips to Syracuse to educate its tyrants all failed.

title.zh: 吕克昂之师 · 亚历山大的老师

desc.zh: 生于斯塔基拉，学于柏拉图学园二十年；前343年应腓力二世之召教导少年亚历山大；前335年回雅典创立吕克昂。逻辑、物理、生物、伦理、政治、诗学皆成体系，中世纪阿拉伯与拉丁世界奉为"大哲"。
desc.en: Born at Stagira, twenty years in Plato's Academy; tutored the young Alexander at Pella from 343; founded the Lyceum in Athens in 335. Logic, physics, biology, ethics, politics and poetics all systematised; "the Philosopher" to medieval Arabs and Latins alike.

desc.zh: 二十岁继位，十一年间从希腊打到印度河，灭阿契美尼德帝国，建亚历山大里亚诸城。三十二岁病逝巴比伦，帝国分裂为继业者诸王国，希腊化时代由此开始。
desc.en: King at twenty; in eleven years marched from Greece to the Indus, destroyed the Achaemenid empire and founded a string of Alexandrias. Died at Babylon aged 32; his generals carved up the empire, opening the Hellenistic age.

desc.zh: 托勒密一世时在亚历山大里亚讲学。《几何原本》十三卷从五条公设出发推演全部平面与立体几何，是公理化方法的范本，两千年来被用作教科书，仅次于《圣经》的印数。
desc.en: Taught at Alexandria under Ptolemy I. The thirteen books of the Elements derive all of plane and solid geometry from five postulates: the model of the axiomatic method, used as a textbook for over two thousand years.

title.zh: 叙拉古的数学家与工程师

desc.zh: 求出圆周率上下界与球体积，以穷竭法预示积分；浮力原理、杠杆、螺旋提水器皆出其手。罗马围攻叙拉古时以投石机与起重爪守城两年，城破时死于一名罗马士兵之手。
desc.en: Bounded π, found the volume of the sphere, and anticipated the calculus with the method of exhaustion; buoyancy, the lever and the screw pump are his. His engines held Syracuse against Rome for two years; he was killed by a soldier when the city fell.

desc.zh: 征羯陵伽后悔悟，皈依佛教，以"法"治国，在全印度及阿富汗立石柱与摩崖铭文宣告其政令，遣使至锡兰、希腊化诸国传法。佛教由此成为世界性宗教。
desc.en: After the bloody conquest of Kalinga he turned to Buddhism and ruled by dhamma, proclaiming his edicts on pillars and rocks from Afghanistan to the south, and sending missions to Ceylon and the Hellenistic kings. Buddhism became a world religion through him.

desc.zh: 前218年率军携战象翻越阿尔卑斯山入意大利，坎尼一役歼灭罗马八个军团，在意大利转战十五年未败，却因无力攻城而失势；扎马败于西庇阿后流亡，于比提尼亚服毒。
desc.en: Crossed the Alps with elephants in 218 BCE, annihilated eight Roman legions at Cannae and campaigned unbeaten in Italy for fifteen years, yet could not take Rome. Beaten at Zama by Scipio, he died in exile in Bithynia by poison.

desc.zh: 征服高卢八年，前49年渡卢比孔河开内战，击败庞培，改历法为儒略历，受任终身独裁官；前44年3月15日在元老院被布鲁图斯等刺杀。共和国随之终结。
desc.en: Conquered Gaul in eight years, crossed the Rubicon in 49 BCE, defeated Pompey, reformed the calendar and was made dictator for life; stabbed in the Senate on the Ides of March 44. The Republic died with him.

desc.zh: 凯撒养子屋大维，亚克兴击败安东尼与克娄巴特拉后独揽大权，前27年获"奥古斯都"尊号，以共和之名行帝制之实，开创两百年"罗马和平"。
desc.en: Caesar's heir Octavian; after Actium he held sole power, took the name Augustus in 27 BCE and ruled as emperor behind republican forms, opening two centuries of Pax Romana.

desc.zh: 加利利传道者，约公元30年在耶路撒冷被罗马总督彼拉多钉十字架。门徒宣称其复活，基督教由此在罗马帝国境内传播，三百年后成为国教。
desc.en: Galilean preacher crucified at Jerusalem under Pontius Pilate c. 30 CE. His followers proclaimed his resurrection; within three centuries their faith was the religion of the Roman state.

desc.zh: 大数的犹太人、罗马公民，原迫害基督徒，在大马士革途中归信。三次传教旅行遍及小亚细亚与希腊，书信成为《新约》半数篇章，使基督教从犹太教派变为普世宗教。殉道于罗马。
desc.en: Jew of Tarsus and Roman citizen, converted on the road to Damascus. Three missionary journeys across Anatolia and Greece; his letters make up half the New Testament and turned a Jewish sect into a universal faith. Martyred at Rome.

desc.zh: 西班牙出身的首位行省籍皇帝。征达契亚，灭纳巴泰，东征至波斯湾，帝国版图达于极盛；在罗马建图拉真广场与纪功柱，元老院誉之"最佳元首"。
desc.en: First emperor from the provinces (Spain). Conquered Dacia, annexed Nabataea and reached the Persian Gulf; the empire was never larger. Built his Forum and Column at Rome; the Senate called him optimus princeps.

title.zh: 亚历山大里亚的天文学家

desc.zh: 《天文学大成》以地心模型与本轮均轮解释行星运动，精度足以沿用一千四百年；《地理学》列出八千地点经纬度，是文艺复兴地图学的起点。
desc.en: The Almagest explained planetary motion with a geocentric system of epicycles accurate enough to last fourteen centuries; the Geography listed eight thousand places by latitude and longitude and launched Renaissance cartography.

desc.zh: 帕加马人，先为角斗士医生，后为马可·奥勒留御医。解剖猿猴与猪，建立以四体液为核心的医学体系，著作逾三百卷，统治欧洲与伊斯兰医学至十六世纪。
desc.en: Of Pergamon; physician to gladiators, then to Marcus Aurelius. Dissected apes and pigs and built a system on the four humours; over three hundred works that ruled European and Islamic medicine until the sixteenth century.

desc.zh: 312年米尔维安桥一战前见十字异象，次年颁米兰敕令承认基督教；325年主持尼西亚公会议；330年迁都拜占庭，更名君士坦丁堡，为东罗马奠基千年。
desc.en: Saw a cross before the Milvian Bridge in 312; the Edict of Milan followed in 313 and the Council of Nicaea in 325. In 330 he moved the capital to Byzantium, renamed Constantinople, the seat of the Eastern empire for a thousand years.

desc.zh: 努米底亚人，青年放浪，米兰受洗，归乡任希波主教。《忏悔录》是西方第一部自传，《上帝之城》回应罗马陷落、奠定中世纪政治神学。汪达尔人围城时病逝。
desc.en: Numidian; a wayward youth, baptised at Milan, bishop of Hippo. The Confessions is the West's first autobiography; The City of God, written after the sack of Rome, set the terms of medieval political theology. Died as the Vandals besieged his city.

title.zh: 法典编纂者 · 圣索菲亚之主

desc.zh: 以贝利撒留收复北非与意大利，编《民法大全》成为欧陆法系之源，重建圣索菲亚大教堂，关闭雅典学园。疫病与波斯战争耗尽国力，光复的疆土在他死后大半丢失。
desc.en: Through Belisarius he retook Africa and Italy; his Corpus Juris Civilis is the root of civil law; he rebuilt Hagia Sophia and closed the Academy at Athens. Plague and the Persian wars drained the empire, and most of the reconquests were lost after his death.

desc.zh: 麦加古莱什商人，四十岁始受启示。622年迁麦地那建立乌玛，630年无血收复麦加，去世时阿拉伯半岛已统一于伊斯兰。启示结集为《古兰经》。
desc.en: Quraysh merchant of Mecca who began receiving revelations at forty. The hijra to Medina in 622 founded the umma; Mecca submitted in 630, and at his death Arabia was united under Islam. The revelations were collected as the Qur'an.

title.zh: 唐代高僧 · 西行求法

desc.zh: 629年私自出关，经高昌、碎叶、撒马尔罕入印度，在那烂陀寺学习五年，645年携657部经典回长安，译经七十五部。《大唐西域记》是中亚与印度七世纪的第一手史料。
desc.en: Left China illegally in 629, crossed Gaochang, Suyab and Samarkand into India, studied five years at Nalanda and returned to Chang'an in 645 with 657 texts, translating 75. His Record of the Western Regions is the primary source for seventh-century Central Asia and India.

title.zh: 法兰克国王 · 罗马人的皇帝

desc.zh: 统一西欧大部，征萨克森三十年，800年圣诞日在罗马受教宗加冕为皇帝。以亚琛为都，召阿尔琴等学者兴学，是为加洛林文艺复兴；其帝国在孙辈手中三分，成法、德雏形。
desc.en: United most of western Europe, fought the Saxons for thirty years, and was crowned emperor by the pope at Rome on Christmas Day 800. From Aachen he sponsored Alcuin's schools, the Carolingian renaissance; his grandsons split the empire into the seeds of France and Germany.

desc.zh: 花剌子模人，在巴格达智慧宫工作。《还原与对消计算概要》首次系统处理一次与二次方程，书名即 algebra 之源；其印度数字论著拉丁译本使"algorithm"一词来自他的名字。
desc.en: From Khwarazm; worked at the House of Wisdom in Baghdad. His book on "restoring and balancing" gave algebra its name and its first systematic treatment of linear and quadratic equations; the Latin version of his treatise on Indian numerals gave us the word algorithm.

desc.zh: 布哈拉人，十八岁通晓当世学问，一生在中亚与波斯诸宫廷间辗转。《医典》综合希腊与阿拉伯医学，在欧洲大学用作教材至十七世纪；《治疗论》把亚里士多德与新柏拉图主义融为一体。
desc.en: Of Bukhara; master of all learning by eighteen, he drifted between Central Asian and Persian courts. The Canon of Medicine fused Greek and Arabic medicine and was a European university text into the 1600s; the Book of Healing wove Aristotle with Neoplatonism.

title.zh: 诺曼底公爵 · 英格兰国王
title.en: Duke of Normandy, King of England

desc.zh: 1066年渡海在黑斯廷斯击杀哈罗德，取英格兰王位。以诺曼贵族取代盎格鲁-撒克逊贵族，建伦敦塔，编《末日审判书》清查全国土地。诺曼法语融入英语，英国与大陆从此纠缠四百年。
desc.en: Crossed the Channel in 1066 and killed Harold at Hastings. Replaced the English nobility with Normans, built the Tower of London and surveyed the kingdom in Domesday Book. Norman French entered English, and England was bound to the Continent for four centuries.

desc.zh: 库尔德人，统一埃及与叙利亚，1187年哈丁之战全歼十字军野战军，收复耶路撒冷而不屠城。与狮心理查的较量使他在欧洲骑士文学中成为宽宏的敌人典范。
desc.en: A Kurd who united Egypt and Syria; at Hattin in 1187 he destroyed the Crusader field army and retook Jerusalem without a massacre. His duel with Richard the Lionheart made him, in European romance, the model of the chivalrous foe.

desc.zh: 铁木真统一蒙古诸部，1206年称成吉思汗。灭西夏、金、花剌子模，兵锋至伏尔加与印度河。其子孙建立人类史上最大的陆地帝国，欧亚贸易与瘟疫同在其驿路上流动。
desc.en: Temüjin united the Mongol tribes and took the title in 1206. He destroyed Western Xia, Jin and Khwarazm and reached the Volga and the Indus; his descendants ruled the largest land empire in history, along whose post-roads moved both trade and plague.

desc.zh: 那不勒斯贵族出身的多明我会士，在巴黎与科隆从大阿尔伯特学习。《神学大全》用亚里士多德的方法为基督教信仰建立理性体系，是天主教官方哲学的基石。
desc.en: A Dominican of Neapolitan nobility, trained under Albert the Great in Paris and Cologne. The Summa Theologica used Aristotle's method to build a rational structure for Christian faith; it remains the backbone of Catholic philosophy.

desc.zh: 1271年随父叔经波斯与帕米尔到上都，侍奉忽必烈十七年，由海路经苏门答腊、印度回国。狱中口述《寰宇记》，成为欧洲对中国的第一手印象，哥伦布随身携带此书。
desc.en: Left in 1271 with his father and uncle via Persia and the Pamirs to Shangdu; served Kublai Khan seventeen years and returned by sea through Sumatra and India. Dictated in prison, his Travels fixed Europe's image of China; Columbus carried a copy.

desc.zh: 佛罗伦萨政争失败被放逐，流亡二十年间以托斯卡纳方言写成《神曲》，游历地狱、炼狱、天堂。此作使意大利语成为文学语言，但丁被称为"意大利语之父"。卒于拉文纳。
desc.en: Exiled from Florence by faction, he spent twenty years wandering and wrote the Divine Comedy in Tuscan vernacular: a journey through Hell, Purgatory and Paradise that made Italian a literary language. Died at Ravenna.

desc.zh: 丹吉尔人，1325年赴麦加朝圣，此后三十年走遍伊斯兰世界：东非、安纳托利亚、金帐汗国、德里苏丹国、马尔代夫、苏门答腊、中国，最后穿撒哈拉至马里。行程十二万公里，三倍于马可·波罗。
desc.en: From Tangier; set out for Mecca in 1325 and kept going for thirty years: East Africa, Anatolia, the Golden Horde, the Delhi Sultanate, the Maldives, Sumatra, China, and finally across the Sahara to Mali. Some 120,000 km, three times Marco Polo.

desc.zh: 突厥化蒙古人，以撒马尔罕为都，三十五年间横扫波斯、金帐汗国、德里、大马士革、安卡拉，以人头筑塔闻名；同时把各地工匠掳往撒马尔罕，建成中亚建筑的黄金时代。东征明朝途中病逝。
desc.en: A Turco-Mongol who made Samarkand his capital and in thirty-five years overran Persia, the Golden Horde, Delhi, Damascus and Ankara, infamous for towers of skulls; he also deported craftsmen to Samarkand and built the golden age of Central Asian architecture. Died marching on Ming China.

desc.zh: 美因茨金匠，约1440年把金属活字、油性墨与螺旋压榨机组合成印刷系统，1455年印出四十二行《圣经》。五十年内欧洲印书两千万册，宗教改革与科学革命皆由此加速。
desc.en: A Mainz goldsmith who around 1440 combined metal type, oil-based ink and the screw press into a printing system; the 42-line Bible appeared in 1455. Within fifty years Europe had printed twenty million books; Reformation and scientific revolution both rode on it.

title.zh: 征服者 · 君士坦丁堡的攻克者

desc.zh: 二十一岁攻陷君士坦丁堡，终结千年东罗马，以之为奥斯曼新都。随后征服塞尔维亚、波斯尼亚、特拉布宗、克里米亚，自称"罗马凯撒"，招贝利尼绘像，宫廷通希腊、拉丁、波斯文。
desc.en: Took Constantinople at twenty-one, ending the thousand-year Eastern empire and making it the Ottoman capital. Then Serbia, Bosnia, Trebizond, Crimea; styled himself Caesar of Rome, sat for Bellini, and kept a court fluent in Greek, Latin and Persian.

title.zh: 画家 · 工程师 · 解剖学家

desc.zh: 芬奇村私生子，佛罗伦萨学画，米兰为斯福尔扎工作十七年，《最后的晚餐》《蒙娜丽莎》出自其手。数千页笔记涉及解剖、水力、飞行器与战争机械，大多生前未发表。晚年受法王弗朗索瓦一世供养，卒于昂布瓦斯。
desc.en: Illegitimate son from Vinci, trained in Florence, seventeen years in Milan for the Sforza: the Last Supper and Mona Lisa. Thousands of notebook pages on anatomy, hydraulics, flying machines and war engines, mostly unpublished. Died at Amboise as guest of Francis I.

desc.zh: 波兰教士，克拉科夫与博洛尼亚求学，终生在弗龙堡任教士。《天体运行论》把太阳置于宇宙中心，1543年临终才付梓。此书开启科学革命，九十年后伽利略因之受审。
desc.en: A Polish canon educated at Kraków and Bologna who spent his life at Frombork. On the Revolutions of the Heavenly Spheres put the Sun at the centre; it was printed as he lay dying in 1543. The scientific revolution begins here; Galileo was tried over it ninety years later.

title.zh: 雕塑家 · 画家 · 建筑师

desc.zh: 佛罗伦萨人，二十四岁作《圣殇》，二十九岁完成《大卫》，1508–12年独自绘西斯廷天顶画，晚年主持圣彼得大教堂穹顶。自认雕塑家，却在三门艺术中都定义了文艺复兴盛期。
desc.en: Florentine; the Pietà at twenty-four, David at twenty-nine, the Sistine ceiling alone from 1508 to 1512, the dome of St Peter's in old age. He called himself a sculptor, and defined the High Renaissance in all three arts.

desc.zh: 奥古斯丁会修士、维滕贝格大学教授，1517年张贴《九十五条论纲》反对赎罪券，1521年沃尔姆斯帝国议会上拒绝撤回。藏身瓦尔特堡时译《新约》为德语，奠定现代德语。
desc.en: Augustinian friar and Wittenberg professor; posted the Ninety-five Theses against indulgences in 1517 and refused to recant at Worms in 1521. Hidden in the Wartburg he translated the New Testament into German, shaping the modern language.

desc.zh: 在位四十六年，取贝尔格莱德、罗得岛、布达，1529年围维也纳，海军控制地中海。土耳其人称他"立法者"，整顿法典；希南为他建苏莱曼尼耶清真寺。
desc.en: Reigned forty-six years: took Belgrade, Rhodes and Buda, besieged Vienna in 1529, and his fleet ruled the Mediterranean. The Turks call him the Lawgiver for his legal code; Sinan built the Süleymaniye for him.

title.zh: 莫卧儿帝国第三代皇帝

desc.zh: 十三岁继位，征服北印度大部，废除对印度教徒的人头税，娶拉杰普特公主，召集各教辩论并创"神圣宗教"。文盲却藏书二万四千卷，法塔赫布尔西格里城是其宫廷的缩影。
desc.en: Emperor at thirteen; conquered most of northern India, abolished the poll tax on Hindus, married Rajput princesses and held interfaith debates that led to his own Din-i Ilahi. Illiterate, he kept a library of 24,000 volumes; Fatehpur Sikri is his court in stone.

title.zh: 现代科学方法的奠基者

desc.zh: 1609年自制望远镜，发现木星卫星、月球山脉与金星盈亏；用斜面实验建立落体定律。1633年因支持日心说被宗教裁判所判软禁，在狱中写成《两门新科学》。
desc.en: Built a telescope in 1609 and found Jupiter's moons, lunar mountains and the phases of Venus; established the law of falling bodies with inclined planes. Condemned by the Inquisition in 1633 for Copernicanism, he wrote the Two New Sciences under house arrest.

desc.zh: 法国人，三十年战争中从军，1628年后隐居荷兰二十年。《方法谈》以"我思故我在"为起点重建知识，解析几何把代数与几何合一。应瑞典女王克里斯蒂娜之邀赴斯德哥尔摩，不耐严寒而亡。
desc.en: Frenchman who soldiered in the Thirty Years' War, then hid in Holland for twenty years. The Discourse on Method rebuilt knowledge from "I think, therefore I am"; analytic geometry joined algebra to geometry. Died of the cold in Stockholm at Queen Christina's court.

title.en: Painter of the Dutch Golden Age

desc.zh: 莱顿磨坊主之子，阿姆斯特丹成名，《夜巡》《解剖课》《自画像》系列以明暗和心理深度著称。1656年破产，晚年孤独而作品愈见深沉。蚀刻版画亦为一代宗师。
desc.en: A Leiden miller's son who made his name in Amsterdam: the Night Watch, the Anatomy Lesson, and a lifetime of self-portraits in light and shadow. Bankrupt in 1656, lonely in old age, his late work grew only deeper. Also the master etcher of his century.

desc.zh: 林肯郡农家子，剑桥求学，1665年瘟疫年在家乡发现万有引力、微积分与光的色散。1687年《自然哲学的数学原理》以三大定律统一天地力学。晚年任皇家造币厂厂长、皇家学会会长。
desc.en: Lincolnshire farm boy, Cambridge scholar; in the plague year 1665 at home he found gravitation, the calculus and the composition of light. The Principia of 1687 united the mechanics of heaven and earth under three laws. Later Master of the Mint and President of the Royal Society.

desc.zh: 1697年化名随使团游历荷兰与英国，亲自在船厂做工。回国后剃贵族胡须、改历法、建海军，1703年在涅瓦河口沼泽上建圣彼得堡，1709年波尔塔瓦击败瑞典，俄国跻身欧洲列强。
desc.en: Travelled incognito to Holland and England in 1697 and worked in the shipyards himself. Back home he shaved the boyars, reformed the calendar, built a navy, founded St Petersburg on the Neva marshes in 1703 and beat Sweden at Poltava in 1709: Russia had joined the European powers.

desc.zh: 图林根音乐世家出身，先后任魏玛宫廷乐师、科滕乐长，1723年起任莱比锡圣托马斯教堂乐监二十七年。《马太受难曲》《B小调弥撒》《平均律》《赋格的艺术》；生前以管风琴家闻名，死后八十年才被门德尔松重新发现。
desc.en: Of a Thuringian musical dynasty; court organist at Weimar, Kapellmeister at Köthen, then cantor of St Thomas, Leipzig for twenty-seven years. The St Matthew Passion, B-minor Mass, Well-Tempered Clavier and Art of Fugue; famed in life as an organist, rediscovered by Mendelssohn eighty years after his death.

desc.zh: 两度入巴士底狱，流亡英国三年归来写《哲学通信》。为卡拉斯冤案奔走平反，以讽刺小说《老实人》嘲弄"一切都是最好的安排"。晚年居日内瓦边境费尔奈，与全欧通信两万封。
desc.en: Twice in the Bastille, three years exiled in England, he returned with the Philosophical Letters. Fought to clear the Calas case; mocked "the best of all possible worlds" in Candide. From Ferney on the Geneva border he wrote twenty thousand letters to all Europe.

desc.zh: 一生未离开哥尼斯堡百里之外，散步准时到邻居可对表。《纯粹理性批判》划定理性的边界，道德哲学以"绝对命令"立法，《论永久和平》提出国际联盟构想。
desc.en: Never travelled a hundred miles from Königsberg; neighbours set their clocks by his walk. The Critique of Pure Reason mapped the limits of reason, his ethics rests on the categorical imperative, and Perpetual Peace sketched a league of nations.

desc.zh: 格拉斯哥仪器匠，1765年想到分离冷凝器，使纽科门机效率提高四倍；与博尔顿合伙在伯明翰制造，1781年发明旋转运动装置，蒸汽机从矿井抽水机变为工厂动力。"马力"与功率单位"瓦特"皆由他而来。
desc.en: Glasgow instrument-maker who in 1765 hit on the separate condenser, quadrupling the Newcomen engine's efficiency; with Boulton at Birmingham he built them, and rotary motion in 1781 turned the mine pump into factory power. "Horsepower" and the watt are his legacy.

desc.zh: 德意志小邦公主，1762年政变推翻丈夫彼得三世登基。与伏尔泰、狄德罗通信，三次瓜分波兰，夺取克里米亚与黑海北岸，建冬宫藏画为艾尔米塔什之始。
desc.en: A minor German princess who overthrew her husband Peter III in 1762. Corresponded with Voltaire and Diderot, partitioned Poland three times, took Crimea and the Black Sea coast, and began the Hermitage collection.

desc.zh: 科西嘉炮兵军官，1799年政变掌权，1804年称帝。奥斯特利茨、耶拿大胜，《民法典》传遍欧陆；1812年征俄六十万大军仅存数万，1815年滑铁卢败后流放圣赫勒拿岛。
desc.en: Corsican artillery officer; seized power in 1799, emperor in 1804. Austerlitz and Jena; the Civil Code spread across the Continent. Of 600,000 who marched on Russia in 1812 a few tens of thousands returned; after Waterloo in 1815, exile on St Helena.

desc.zh: 波恩人，1792年赴维也纳从海顿学习，再未离开。三十岁起渐聋，1802年写下海利根施塔特遗书却继续创作：《英雄》《命运》《田园》、晚期四重奏，1824年全聋时指挥《第九交响曲》首演。
desc.en: From Bonn to Vienna in 1792 to study with Haydn, and never left. Deafness set in at thirty; the Heiligenstadt Testament of 1802 was followed by the Eroica, the Fifth, the Pastoral, the late quartets, and in 1824, stone deaf, the premiere of the Ninth.

desc.zh: 1831–36年随小猎犬号环球航行，加拉帕戈斯群岛的雀鸟使他怀疑物种不变。沉默二十年后，1859年《物种起源》以自然选择解释生命的多样性，是现代生物学的基石。
desc.en: Sailed round the world on the Beagle in 1831–36; the finches of the Galápagos made him doubt the fixity of species. After twenty years' silence, the Origin of Species of 1859 explained the diversity of life by natural selection, the foundation of modern biology.

desc.zh: 特里尔人，柏林学黑格尔，被普鲁士、法国、比利时相继驱逐，1849年起定居伦敦，在大英博物馆阅览室写《资本论》。与恩格斯合著《共产党宣言》，其思想在二十世纪改变了半个世界的政权。
desc.en: From Trier; Hegelian at Berlin, expelled in turn by Prussia, France and Belgium, settled in London from 1849 and wrote Capital in the British Museum reading room. The Communist Manifesto with Engels; in the twentieth century his ideas remade the governments of half the world.

desc.zh: 荷兰牧师之子，当过画商、传教士，二十七岁学画。1888年赴阿尔勒，一年半画出《向日葵》《星月夜》《麦田群鸦》，与高更决裂后割耳，三十七岁自尽。生前只卖出一幅画。
desc.en: A Dutch pastor's son, art dealer and missionary before taking up painting at twenty-seven. In Arles from 1888 he painted Sunflowers, Starry Night and the wheatfields in eighteen months, cut his ear after breaking with Gauguin, and died at thirty-seven. He sold one painting in his life.

desc.zh: 1905年在伯尔尼专利局任三级技术员时发表狭义相对论、光电效应、布朗运动三篇论文；1915年柏林完成广义相对论，1919年日食观测证实后成为世界名人。1933年离开纳粹德国赴普林斯顿。
desc.en: In 1905, a third-class clerk at the Bern patent office, he published special relativity, the photoelectric effect and Brownian motion; general relativity followed at Berlin in 1915 and the eclipse of 1919 made him famous. Left Nazi Germany for Princeton in 1933.

desc.zh: 加里波利守将，1919年发动独立战争驱逐希腊与协约国军队，1923年建共和国定都安卡拉。废哈里发、改拉丁字母、男女平权、政教分离，十五年把奥斯曼残骸改造成世俗民族国家。
desc.en: Defender of Gallipoli; from 1919 he led the war of independence against Greek and Allied forces and proclaimed the Republic at Ankara in 1923. Abolished the caliphate, adopted the Latin alphabet, enfranchised women and separated mosque from state: in fifteen years a secular nation from the Ottoman wreck.

wz: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克

desc.zh: 鲁国人，周游列国十四年求用不得，归鲁授徒三千。言行由弟子录为《论语》，仁、礼、孝、中庸之教自汉代起为中国两千年之官学，并及朝鲜、日本、越南。
desc.en: Of Lu; wandered the states fourteen years seeking a ruler to employ him, then taught three thousand disciples. The Analects record his sayings; from the Han dynasty his teaching on humaneness, ritual and filial duty was state orthodoxy for two millennia in China, Korea, Japan and Vietnam.

desc.zh: 十年灭六国，前221年称皇帝。废封建行郡县，统一文字、度量衡、车轨，连长城，筑驰道，焚书坑儒；骊山陵与兵马俑是其权力的遗存。死后三年秦亡。
desc.en: Destroyed the six rival states in ten years and proclaimed himself emperor in 221 BCE. Replaced fiefs with commanderies, unified script, weights, measures and axle widths, joined the Great Wall, built highways, burned books; the Terracotta Army guards his tomb. Qin fell three years after his death.

desc.zh: 李世民，玄武门之变后即位，纳谏任贤，击灭东突厥，被草原诸部尊为"天可汗"。贞观年间长安成为欧亚最大都市，接纳景教、祆教、佛教与各国使节，玄奘归国受其接见。
desc.en: Li Shimin took the throne after the Xuanwu Gate coup, listened to remonstrance, crushed the Eastern Turks and was hailed "Heavenly Khan" by the steppe. Under him Chang'an was the largest city in Eurasia, open to Nestorians, Zoroastrians, Buddhists and envoys from every quarter; he received Xuanzang on his return.

desc.zh: 成吉思汗之孙，1260年称大汗，1271年建元，1279年灭南宋统一中国，定都大都。开通惠河、立行省、用色目人理财，接见马可·波罗；两征日本皆败于台风。
desc.en: Grandson of Genghis; Great Khan in 1260, founded the Yuan in 1271 and completed the conquest of Song China in 1279, ruling from Dadu. Built the Grand Canal's last link, set up provinces, employed Central Asians in finance, received Marco Polo; both invasions of Japan were wrecked by typhoons.

desc.zh: 云南穆斯林，靖难之役后为永乐帝心腹，1405–33年七次率宝船队远航，最大船队两万七千人，远抵霍尔木兹、亚丁、麦加、东非马林迪。船队规模百年内无人能及，却在明朝海禁后被遗忘。
desc.en: A Yunnan Muslim and favourite of the Yongle emperor; seven voyages in 1405–33 with fleets of up to 27,000 men reached Hormuz, Aden, Mecca and Malindi in East Africa. Nothing matched their scale for a century, and the Ming sea ban buried their memory.

desc.zh: 生于巴尔赫，蒙古西侵时举家西迁至科尼亚。遇流浪苦行者沙姆斯后转为诗人，《玛斯纳维》二万五千联句被称为"波斯语的古兰经"。其门徒创梅夫拉维教团，即"旋转托钵僧"。
desc.en: Born at Balkh, his family fled the Mongols to Konya. Meeting the wandering dervish Shams turned him into a poet; the Masnavi's 25,000 couplets are called "the Qur'an in Persian". His followers founded the Mevlevi order, the whirling dervishes.
